title: Codelab Companion Character Pack
description: Schema for an optional codelab companion character pack resolved by scripts/characters.cjs.

version.description: Semantic version of the character pack specification.

companion_theme.description: Human-readable name of the companion cast or narrative theme.

character_bible.description: Optional path (relative to characters.json) to a Markdown character bible.

skill_assets_path.description: Optional relative directory holding character sheets and reference images.

id.description: Stable slug identifier for the character.

name.description: Display name used in tutorial callouts.

role.description: Pedagogical role in the tutorial (for example builder, architect, or debugger).

pronouns.description: Pronouns used when referring to the character.

callout_label.description: Default bold label used inside > aside callout blocks.

icons.description: Avatar badge paths (either an array of relative paths or a named mood map).

visual_prompt_descriptor.description: Detailed visual prompt snippet passed exclusively to image generators.

comics.description: Optional map of reusable setup comic slots to relative image paths.
